timeBase.basis: every *T / t field: lap t (s) of the shipped lap JSON = GPS time base = viewer playback clock (0 = first GPS sample of the lap)
timeBase.shift: 7/30: meta.channel_time_alignment.shiftSeconds of the lap, applied to IMU and ECU alike; 7/29: 0
timeBase.lapClock: HUD / video-overlay lap clock = t + lapClockOffsetS (keyTimesLapClock)
timeBase.tc0: XRK timecode of lap t = 0, re-derived from XRK GPS Speed vs the shipped lap speed (rms 0.0003 km/h) and equal to kerb_contacts.json timeBase.lapMapping for all 10 laps
timeBase.gpsSpeed: GPS Speed sample times are moved 0.09 s earlier (Doppler speed lags positions)

labels.measured: event times and values from logger samples (with interpolation)
labels.derived: stations (keyStationsDerived, stationAtPeakDerived) and passWindowT from the shipped registered GPS path; kerb attribution of contacts uses them
labels.reference: publishedPassLabel / publishedEventAgreement (kerb_contacts.json) and viewerApex (apex_kpi.json) are viewer outputs, not ground truth

detection.rr: published kerb_contacts.json detector, recomputed from the native XRK: RollRate minus its 15-sample moving average, RMS over 10 samples (0.2 s), event = RMS > 1.0 deg/s, merged across gaps <= 15 samples (reproduces all 44 published events within the 0.01 s rounding)
detection.va: VerticalAcc high-pass 4 Hz (4th-order Butterworth, zero-phase), centred 3-sample RMS; cluster = samples above detectLevel = max(median + 10 sigma, 5 median) of the lap straight-line baseline, merged across gaps < 0.25 s
detection.candidate: RR events and VA clusters overlapping within 0.10 s form one contact candidate

timing.signals: VerticalAcc and RollRate, each high-pass 4 Hz (4th-order Butterworth, zero-phase filtfilt on the native samples) and centred 3-sample RMS (0.06 s window; can lead a step onset by <= 1 sample)
timing.baseline: straight-line, no-brake samples (|LateralAcc LP1.5Hz| < 0.25 g, |yaw LP1.5Hz - bias| < 4 deg/s, ECU_VEH_SPD > 40 km/h, ECU_BRK_P < 3 bar) in [candidateStart - 8 s, candidateStart - 0.5 s]; >= 25 samples, else the same selection over the whole lap (baselineScope = lap)
timing.onsetLevel: F * max(median + 4 sigma, 2.5 median); F = 1 for VerticalAcc, 2 for RollRate (in-corner / straight RollRate noise ratio measured 1.8-2.1 at > 0.8 g, both sessions; VerticalAcc ratio ~1)
timing.onset: first upward crossing of onsetLevel (linear interpolation between the two samples) that starts a run of >= 2 samples above it, searched in [candidateStart - 0.3 s, channel peak]; if the signal is already above at the search start the walk back continues up to 0.5 s; the walk never crosses the end (detector end or refined offset, whichever is later) of the previous candidate. No crossing found -> channel onset null (flag elevatedBackground / onsetBoundedByPreviousContact); contact onset falls back to the detector start (flag onsetFromDetector)
timing.offset: last downward crossing of onsetLevel in [channel peak, min(candidateEnd + 0.5 s, next candidate start)]; none -> null (flag offsetAtSearchLimit / offsetBoundedByNextContact), contact offset falls back to the detector end (flag offsetFromDetector)
timing.peak: 3-point parabola on the RMS maximum inside [candidateStart - 0.1 s, candidateEnd + 0.1 s] (clipped to the previous / next candidate)
timing.contactOnset: earliest onset of the responding channels (a channel responds when its peak exceeds its onsetLevel)
timing.contactPeak: peakT = sharp RollRate peak when RollRate responds, else sharp VerticalAcc peak; detectorPeakT = RR-detector peak (published tPeak) or VA-cluster peak, used for the kerb attribution

kerbContact.attribution: as export_inputs.attribute: CG station at the contact peak (RR detector peak when present, else VA peak); an inside kerb whose pass window (+-0.2 s) holds the peak time and whose range (+-3 m) holds the station, deepest first; else any kerb zone within 3 m; else none
kerbContact.confidence: high = RR event and VA responds; medium = RR event only (VA below its onsetLevel); low = VA cluster without an RR event (vertical-only: kerb paint, bump or kerb; not separable from the logger alone)

steer.channel: ECU_STEER_ANG (deg at the wheel, 20 Hz, 1 deg quantisation); right-hand corner = negative values
steer.deltaDir: -cornerDir * (steer - straightOffset); straightOffset = session median at ECU_VEH_SPD > 120 km/h and |LateralAcc LP| < 0.1 g
steer.peak: max of deltaDir LP 2 Hz (zero-phase) in [passStart - 1.0 s, passEnd + 0.5 s], 3-point parabola
steer.walkStart: the valley / onset walk starts at yaw onset + 0.3 s (or at the steering peak if earlier, or if the steering there is still below its threshold) so that mid-corner steering dips are not taken as the pre-corner valley; the steering peak is still the max over the pass window
steer.valley: walking back from walkStart (<= 10 s), the first local minimum of deltaDir LP (5 deg hysteresis) from which deltaDir rises to the peak by >= max(10 deg, 0.4 * peak) and whose level is <= max(8 deg, 0.25 * peak), or <= max(8 deg, 0.5 * peak) when it lies before the pass window; other minima (mid-corner dips, partial unwinding) are walked through
steer.cases: valley < -max(8 deg, 0.3 peak): linkedOpposite, baseline = 0 (straight-ahead); valley > 8 deg: linkedSame, baseline = valley level (LP); both with sigma = session straight-line sigma; otherwise isolated, baseline = raw median over [valley - 1 s, valley + 0.1 s], sigma = 1.4826 MAD clipped to [0.5 deg, 2 x session sigma]
steer.onset: last upward crossing of onsetThreshold by raw deltaDir before the peak (sustained up to the peak by construction, not earlier than valley - 0.5 s), linear interpolation between the 20 Hz samples
steer.rampOnset: line fitted to the raw deltaDir samples between 20 % and 60 % of (peak - baseline) on the first ramp after the onset, intercept with baseline (needs >= 3 samples; rejected if later than onset + 0.1 s or earlier than onset - 2 s)
steer.ratePeak: max of Savitzky-Golay derivative (5 samples, order 2) of raw deltaDir between onset and the first time deltaDir LP reaches 90 % of (peak - baseline), parabola
steer.release: first time after the peak with deltaDir LP < baseline + 0.3 (peak - baseline)

yaw.channel: YawRate (deg/s, 50 Hz IMU); right-hand corner = positive; bias = session median at ECU_VEH_SPD > 120 km/h and |LateralAcc LP| < 0.1 g
yaw.onset: computed BEFORE the steering: steering rule on cornerDir * (yaw LP 5 Hz - bias), with peak/valley on yaw LP 1.5 Hz; peak search [passStart - 1 s, passEnd + 0.5 s]; walk from the yaw peak; thresholds max(1.5 deg/s, 3 sigma), sigma clipped to [0.25 deg/s, 2 x session sigma]; valley hysteresis 2 deg/s, rise >= max(4 deg/s, 0.4 peak), level <= max(3 deg/s, 0.25 peak) (0.5 peak before the pass window); linkedOpposite if valley < -max(3, 0.3 peak) deg/s, linkedSame if valley > 3 deg/s

clip.window: [max(entry - 0.5 s, passStart - 2 s), min(steerRelease + 0.5 s, passEnd + 2 s)], entry = steering onset (yaw onset if missing); [passStart - 1 s, passEnd + 1 s] if both are missing
clip.extremum: each clip marker = the highest interior local maximum (lowest interior local minimum for speed) inside its window, + 3-point parabola; the window max/min (flag atWindowEdge) only when no interior extremum exists
clip.latGPeak: cornerDir * LateralAcc LP 1.5 Hz (zero-phase), max + parabola; plateau = contiguous span >= 97 % of the peak
clip.yawRatePeak: yaw LP 1.5 Hz, max + parabola, plateau >= 97 %
clip.steerMax: deltaDir LP 2 Hz max + parabola (pass window based search), plateau >= 97 %
clip.minSpeed: primary: mean of ECU_WS_RL/RR (non-driven rear wheels, 20 Hz, 1 km/h quantisation) LP 2 Hz, min in [max(steerOnset - 1 s, passStart - 2.5 s), min(steerRelease + 1 s, passEnd + 2.5 s)] + parabola; flat = span within +0.5 km/h of the min (bounded by the search window). Secondary: ECU_VEH_SPD LP 2 Hz; GPS Speed (10 Hz) with its time moved 0.09 s earlier (Doppler-speed lag)

brake.channel: ECU_BRK_P (bar, 20 Hz); +inf = no CAN brake message -> 0 bar (as pipeline/convert_aim.py)
brake.onset: upward crossing of 3.0 bar (linear interpolation) at the start of the last brake run (>= 3 bar, gaps < 0.2 s merged, peak >= 5 bar) that starts in [entry - 8 s, entry + 0.5 s] (entry = steering onset, else yaw onset; without either: [passStart - 9 s, minSpeed time]); msgStart = first finite sample of the CAN run holding the onset; release = downward crossing of 3.0 bar at the end of the run
